nodes.label: X-INSIGHT Product Identity
nodes.rationale: Desktop-first decision-support workspace for psychiatrists; calm clinical tone with minimal decoration keeps dense workspaces trustworthy.

nodes.label: Canonical Teal and Neutral Palette
nodes.rationale: Teal reserved for primary actions and selection, semantic colors restricted to badges and stripes, so urgent states stay continuously visible without large saturated fills.

nodes.label: Light-Only Theme Decision
nodes.rationale: No approved dark palette or contrast validation exists, so deriving dark tokens by inversion would ship unvalidated clinical contrast.
